game.intro: The moon moves into Aries and settles into the cabin. Chimney smoking. Show us something that belongs there.
game.prompt: Something that would look right at home in a cabin in the woods.

game.intro: Don't even scream: you both made the same typo. Saturn finds this suspicious and wonderful. Spell badly with pride.
game.question: How do you spell the word necessary?

game.intro: Moon in Taurus: everything is slow, including the bull. Especially the bull. Take your time with this one.
game.prompt: A bull who has decided to moo in extreme slow motion, all afternoon.

game.intro: Good blanket day. Saturn has claimed the corner of the couch. Spell us something worth staying under for.
game.prompt: A cozy movie worth watching under the good blanket.

game.intro: Happy Valentine's Day to the best pals in the cosmos. Saturn brought cards. Bring two truths and one whopper.
game.prompt: Three things you've never told each other. One of them is a complete fib.

game.intro: Two loud opinions walk into the studio. Moon in Gemini. Ten seconds each and no fence-sitting allowed.
Forty tabs open, one of them is playing music, and Saturn can't find which. Pick yours, guess theirs.
game.question: Which tab is open in the back of your brain right now?

game.intro: A shell on the windowsill brought the shore home. Get close enough that it looks like a whole new planet.
game.prompt: Something sitting on a windowsill in your home, shot so close it could be a planet.

game.intro: DES! The same blue jay visited twice. Saturn has filed a full report and would like your wrongest testimony.
game.question: What colour is a blue jay?

game.intro: Full moon in Leo and the lion is warming up backstage. The crew wants to hear every scale.
game.prompt: A lion doing vocal warm-ups backstage before its big show.

game.intro: The Great February Recharge! Ruby and onyx on the sill, side by side. The paparazzi are already outside.
game.headline: FULL MOON CAUGHT CHARGING ___ ON A WINDOWSILL, ONYX DENIES EVERYTHING

game.intro: Tidy afterglow day. Saturn has swept up the moonlight and wants a year. Close, but not over.
game.question: In what year did the Confederation Bridge to Prince Edward Island open to traffic?
game.source: Confederation Bridge opened to traffic on May 31, 1997.

game.intro: A lid has gone missing and Saturn suspects everyone. Answer fast so you look innocent.
Moon in Libra and a spoon balanced on a mug. Saturn holds his breath. Pick your trick, guess theirs.
game.question: Which spoon trick would you most like to master?

game.intro: Even trade day. Saturn is running the swap meet and he wants to see the goods up close.
game.prompt: Something you'd happily trade for a cup of something hot.

game.intro: Don't even scream: two identical snowmen in two different yards. Saturn wants answers. Wrong ones.
game.question: What do you traditionally use for a snowman's nose?

game.intro: Somewhere in the house is a secret drawer. Saturn is releasing the suspense music budget.
game.prompt: A creaky old drawer sliding open to reveal a secret, with your own suspense music.

game.intro: The arrow points toward March and the moon is in Sagittarius, bow drawn. Saturn wants your bravest plan.
game.prompt: Something you're bravely planning to try once March arrives.

game.intro: February takes its final bow. Saturn is throwing roses. Send it off with two truths and one beautiful lie.
game.prompt: Three things you'd seal in a February time capsule. One of them is invented.

game.intro: February opens with a mitten that refuses to go on. Focus. Ten seconds each. Saturn is timing you with a sundial.
The moon drops by Nancy's mountain and a groundhog drops by the studio. Pick your forecast, guess theirs.
game.question: A groundhog pops up and offers you a forecast. Which one are you hoping for?

game.intro: Saturn has a label maker and he is not afraid to use it. Get so close the label can't save them.
game.prompt: Something in your home with a label on it. Zoom in until the words give nothing away.

game.intro: Dark moon, blank page. Saturn wants something written on it and he does not care if it's correct.
game.question: What do you call a word that reads the same forwards and backwards?

game.intro: DES day: two orange shovels, one snowbank, zero explanation. The crew wants to hear that shovel sing.
game.prompt: A metal shovel scraping the driveway at dawn, performed with deep feeling.

game.intro: Breaking: the Tiger and the Rat are throwing a party and Saturn is on the guest list for once. Stop the presses.
game.headline: TIGER AND RAT THROW PARTY, WHOLE TOWN STILL TALKING ABOUT THE ___

game.intro: Sock amnesty day: all strays forgiven. Saturn is less forgiving about guesses that go over.
game.question: How many tiles are in a standard double-six set of dominoes? Smug bonus if you spot why it suits February.
game.source: A double-six domino set has every pairing of 0-6 with repeats: 7x8/2 = 28 tiles.

game.intro: The kettle dreamed last night and it's still a little steamy about it. Three fast picks, no overthinking.
Someone wrote in the fog on the window. Saturn is patient, but he would like to know who.
game.question: You find a message written in the fog on a window. What do you hope it says?
